chunks.text:
[Verse 1]
The request is in a chat from a week ago
The file is in an email, which one, I don't know
Final, final two, really final, send
Where's the latest version? On the laptop of a friend

[Verse 2]
GitHub is a website, nothing more to it
A shared project folder with a message board in it
Who changed what and when, it's all on record
Every single version, you can always check it

[Chorus]
Three words and you're good to go
Repository, that's the folder, so you know
Issue, one thing to do, one thread
Pull request, look first, then go ahead
positive_styles: doubled vocals on the key words

chunks.text:
[Verse 3]
Got a coding agent? Then you don't have to click
Tell it what you want and it opens issues quick
Need a change? Ask it for a PR
We take a look, then merge it, and there you are

[Outro]
Public repo? Keep your secrets out
Made a mistake? Every version's there, no doubt
Novawerk one-oh-one, that's all for today
Let's turn ideas into something real
positive_styles: beat ends cleanly on the last word
